content.short: Loopring is a zkRollup-powered Layer-2 enabling non-custodial exchange and payment protocols.
content.description: Loopring is a Layer-2 solution for Ethereum that uses zkRollup technology to provide fast, affordable transactions. Leveraging zero-knowledge proofs, Loopring batches thousands of transactions off-chain with high accuracy, reducing on-chain congestion while preserving security guarantees. This architecture enables developers to build non-custodial decentralized exchanges with intuitive interfaces, delivering a smoother trading experience and lower costs for users engaging in decentralized markets.
